```{r build-observed-per-edge}
    log_msg(sprintf("WSDOT-eligible edges (not yet seeded): %d",
                    nrow(route_edges)))

    if (nrow(route_edges) > 0 && nrow(wsdot_counts) > 0) {
      # Per edge: nearest WSDOT count point on the same route.
      edge_pts <- route_edges |>
        mutate(
          edge_lon = (dgr_from_x(graph_in)[edge_idx] +
                      dgr_to_x(graph_in)[edge_idx]) / 2,
          edge_lat = (dgr_from_y(graph_in)[edge_idx] +
                      dgr_to_y(graph_in)[edge_idx]) / 2)
      wpts <- wsdot_counts |>
        mutate(state_route = as.character(state_route))

      nearest_per_edge <- edge_pts |>
        inner_join(wpts, by = "state_route",
                   relationship = "many-to-many") |>
        mutate(d2 = (edge_lon - wsdot_lon)^2 + (edge_lat - wsdot_lat)^2) |>
        group_by(edge_idx) |>
        slice_min(d2, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
        ungroup() |>
        # NOTE: `observed_peakhr_vph` is ALREADY per-direction at this
        # point — the upstream wsdot_counts cache halves AADT for
        # BOTHWAYS counts via `one_dir_aadt = AADT / 2` (line ~4511).
        # We previously applied a second 0.5 dir_factor here, which
        # halved the per-direction value AGAIN (net: ¼ of bidirectional
        # AADT, not ½). That's why the freeway seed share was ~18%
        # instead of the expected 30-35%. Each per-direction dodgr edge
        # nearest to a BOTHWAYS count now gets the full per-direction
        # value, which is the correct semantics for through-traffic.
        select(edge_idx, observed_peakhr_vph)

      wsdot_per_edge <- nearest_per_edge
      log_msg(sprintf("WSDOT-filled edges: %d", nrow(wsdot_per_edge)))
    }
  }

  # ---- (f) Combine to per-edge observed vector ----
  out <- numeric(nrow(graph_in))
  # Coerce any residual NAs to 0 — should be empty after the filter above,
  # but defensive against future cascade-result oddities.
  sdot_vals  <- ifelse(is.finite(sdot_per_edge$observed_peakhr_vph),
                        sdot_per_edge$observed_peakhr_vph, 0)
  wsdot_vals <- ifelse(is.finite(wsdot_per_edge$observed_peakhr_vph),
                        wsdot_per_edge$observed_peakhr_vph, 0)
  out[sdot_per_edge$edge_idx]  <- sdot_vals
  out[wsdot_per_edge$edge_idx] <- wsdot_vals
  log_msg(sprintf("Total seeded edges: %d  (SDOT corridor: %d, WSDOT: %d)",
                  sum(out > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
                  nrow(sdot_per_edge), nrow(wsdot_per_edge)))
  log_msg(sprintf("  Median seed: %.0f vph; max: %.0f vph; total: %.0f vph",
                  median(out[out > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(out, na.rm = TRUE),
                  sum(out, na.rm = TRUE)))
  out
}

observed_per_edge <- with_cache("observed_per_edge",
  list(counts_sig  = digest::digest(counts_clean),
       wsdot_sig   = digest::digest(wsdot_counts),
       corridors_sig = digest::digest(corridors),
       snd_sig     = digest::digest(snd_mappings),
       graph_sig   = digest::digest(dgr_edge_id(dodgr_graph_annotated)),
       version     = "v10"),  # v10: WSDOT double-halving bug fixed; bothways
                              # counts now produce per-direction full value
                              # (was ½ × ½ = ¼ of AADT × k previously)
  function() {
    match_classes <- c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary")
    build_observed_per_edge_corridor(
      graph_in       = dodgr_graph_annotated,
      counts_clean   = counts_clean,
      wsdot_counts   = wsdot_counts,
      corridors      = corridors,
      compkey_to_way = compkey_to_way,
      snd_to_way     = snd_to_way,
      way_snd_attrs  = way_snd_attrs,
      route_pairs    = params$wsdot_route_snd_pairs,
      match_classes  = match_classes)
  })
```

```{r run-unseeded-baseline}
log_stage("Stage 13b: Per-TOD unseeded baseline equilibria (for seed computation)")

base_cfg <- config_table |>
  filter(transit_id == "baseline", street_id == "no_pri_no_av")
stopifnot(nrow(base_cfg) == 1)

# We need one unseeded baseline per TOD, because (a) Daysim demand
# changes with TOD, (b) the transit skim slice the MNL sees differs, and
# (c) we need the right per-TOD model_flow_vph to compute `seed = max(0,
# observed_TOD - model_TOD)`. observed_TOD = AMPK × tod_seed_factor[TOD]
# (literature ratio). Cache key includes TOD name so changing
# tods_to_run doesn't invalidate other TODs' caches.
flow_seed_vec_per_tod      <- vector("list", length(params$tods_to_run))
unseeded_baseline_per_tod  <- vector("list", length(params$tods_to_run))
names(flow_seed_vec_per_tod)     <- params$tods_to_run
names(unseeded_baseline_per_tod) <- params$tods_to_run

for (tn in params$tods_to_run) {
  od_tn       <- od_daysim_per_tod[[tn]]
  cal_lookup  <- od_drive_cal_lookup_per_tod[[tn]]
  cal_global  <- global_drive_cal_ratio_per_tod[[tn]]
  hours_tn    <- params$tod_hours_per_day[[tn]]
  if (is.null(hours_tn) || !is.finite(hours_tn) || hours_tn <= 0)
    stop("Invalid tod_hours_per_day for ", tn)

  unseeded_inputs <- list(
    config_id      = sprintf("baseline__no_pri_no_av_UNSEEDED_%s", tn),
    av_shrink      = params$av_drive_tt_shrink,
    bpr_alpha      = params$bpr_alpha, bpr_beta = params$bpr_beta,
    bpr_vc_cap     = params$bpr_vc_cap,
    rel_thr        = params$reliability_vc_threshold,
    rel_lambda     = params$reliability_lambda,
    max_iter       = params$max_iter, rel_tol = params$rel_tol,
    hours_in       = hours_tn,
    auto_occupancy = params$auto_occupancy,
    graph_sig      = digest::digest(list(
      cap_b = dodgr_graph_annotated$cap_vph_baseline,
      cap_p = dodgr_graph_annotated$cap_vph_priority,
      alpha = dodgr_graph_annotated$bpr_alpha_eff)),  # per-edge BPR α
    transit_sig    = digest::digest(transit_skims[[base_cfg$gtfs_combo]]),
    cal_ratio_sig  = digest::digest(cal_lookup$cal_ratio),
    od_sig         = digest::digest(od_tn),
    tod            = tn,
    # v13: MSA-on-flows convergence fix (+ v12 time-based routing fix) changes
    # the unseeded flow load → the derived seed. (v11: cap+α calibration.)
    version        = "v13"
  )
  # Only enters the hash when set, so existing (uncalmed) caches stay valid.
  if (length(params$residential_calm_mph) == 1 &&
      is.finite(params$residential_calm_mph))
    unseeded_inputs$residential_calm <- params$residential_calm_mph
  if (length(params$residential_cap_vph) == 1 &&
      is.finite(params$residential_cap_vph))
    unseeded_inputs$residential_cap <- params$residential_cap_vph
  unseeded_hash <- substr(digest::digest(unseeded_inputs), 1, 12)
  base_unseeded_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, "scenario",
    sprintf("scen_baseline__no_pri_no_av_UNSEEDED_%s_%s.rds",
            tn, unseeded_hash))

  if (file.exists(base_unseeded_cache) && !params$force_rebuild) {
    log_msg(sprintf("[%s] Unseeded baseline cache HIT — loading", tn))
    unseeded_baseline_tn <- readRDS(base_unseeded_cache)
  } else {
    log_msg(sprintf("[%s] Running unseeded baseline equilibrium (flow_seed = 0)...", tn))
    combo  <- base_cfg$gtfs_combo
    if (is.null(transit_skims[[combo]]))
      stop("Baseline transit skim not built — re-run §9.")
    # graph_in with flow_seed = 0 to start (we want pure-MNL load here).
    g_zero_seed <- dodgr_graph_annotated
    g_zero_seed$flow_seed <- rep(0, nrow(g_zero_seed))
    unseeded_baseline_tn <- run_equilibrium_v2(
      config_row          = base_cfg,
      trips_in            = trips_in,
      transit_skim_long   = transit_skims[[combo]],
      graph_in            = g_zero_seed,
      skim_drive_dodgr_in = skim_drive_dodgr,
      od_demand_in        = od_tn,
      tod_bin             = tn,
      dow_type            = "Weekday",
      flow_seed_vec_in    = rep(0, nrow(g_zero_seed)),
      od_cal_lookup_in    = cal_lookup,
      global_cal_ratio_in = cal_global,
      hours_in            = hours_tn,
      residential_calm_mph = params$residential_calm_mph,
      residential_cap_vph = params$residential_cap_vph
    )
    saveRDS(unseeded_baseline_tn, base_unseeded_cache)
  }
  unseeded_baseline_per_tod[[tn]] <- unseeded_baseline_tn

  # Per-edge model flow at unseeded equilibrium for THIS TOD.
  g_un <- unseeded_baseline_tn$graph
  model_flow_vph_tn <- as.numeric(g_un$flow_vph)
  model_flow_vph_tn[!is.finite(model_flow_vph_tn)] <- 0

  # Scale observed AMPK to this TOD using literature ratio.
  seed_factor_tn <- params$tod_seed_factor[[tn]]
  if (is.null(seed_factor_tn) || !is.finite(seed_factor_tn) || seed_factor_tn < 0)
    stop("Invalid tod_seed_factor for ", tn)
  observed_tn <- as.numeric(observed_per_edge) * seed_factor_tn

  # seed = max(0, observed - model). Apply only where observed > 0.
  flow_seed_vec_tn <- pmax(0, observed_tn - model_flow_vph_tn)
  flow_seed_vec_per_tod[[tn]] <- flow_seed_vec_tn

  log_msg(sprintf("[%s] flow_seed: %d edges seeded (median = %.0f vph, max = %.0f vph; AMPK×%.2f)",
                  tn,
                  sum(flow_seed_vec_tn > 0),
                  median(flow_seed_vec_tn[flow_seed_vec_tn > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(flow_seed_vec_tn, na.rm = TRUE),
                  seed_factor_tn))
}

# Back-compat alias: the graph's `flow_seed` is set to the FIRST modeled
# TOD's seed (typically AM). §14 explicitly passes the right per-TOD seed
# into run_equilibrium_v2, so this is only used by code paths that read
# `dodgr_graph_annotated$flow_seed` directly (none in active use).
.default_tod <- params$tods_to_run[[1]]
dodgr_graph_annotated$flow_seed <- flow_seed_vec_per_tod[[.default_tod]]
flow_seed_vec     <- flow_seed_vec_per_tod[[.default_tod]]
log_msg(sprintf("Default-TOD flow_seed (%s) staged on graph; total seeded vph = %.0f",
                .default_tod, sum(flow_seed_vec)))
```


# 14. Run all configurations × TODs

```{r run-all-configs}
log_stage(sprintf("Stage 14: Run all configurations × %d TOD(s) [%s]",
                  length(params$tods_to_run),
                  paste(params$tods_to_run, collapse = ", ")))

# results_list is FLAT: one entry per (config, tod) cell. Each entry's
# bundle$tod identifies the TOD. §15 then groups across both dimensions.
n_cells <- nrow(configs_to_run) * length(params$tods_to_run)
results_list    <- vector("list", n_cells)
results_emp_acc <- vector("list", n_cells)
overall_t0 <- Sys.time()
cell_idx   <- 0L

for (i in seq_len(nrow(configs_to_run))) {
  cfg <- configs_to_run[i, ]
  for (tn in params$tods_to_run) {
    cell_idx <- cell_idx + 1L
    od_tn       <- od_daysim_per_tod[[tn]]
    cal_lookup  <- od_drive_cal_lookup_per_tod[[tn]]
    cal_global  <- global_drive_cal_ratio_per_tod[[tn]]
    seed_vec_tn <- flow_seed_vec_per_tod[[tn]]
    hours_tn    <- params$tod_hours_per_day[[tn]]

    cat("\n", paste(rep("-", 76), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
    log_msg(sprintf("[cell %d/%d] CONFIG %s × TOD %s — %s × %s",
                    cell_idx, n_cells,
                    cfg$config_id, tn, cfg$transit_label, cfg$street_label))
    cat(paste(rep("-", 76), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
    cell_t0 <- Sys.time()

    # Cache key includes the parameters that change scenario outcomes
    # AND the TOD. Bumping any of them invalidates the (config, TOD) cell.
    scen_inputs <- list(
      config_id      = cfg$config_id,
      tod            = tn,
      av_shrink      = params$av_drive_tt_shrink,
      bpr_alpha      = params$bpr_alpha, bpr_beta = params$bpr_beta,
      bpr_vc_cap     = params$bpr_vc_cap,
      rel_thr        = params$reliability_vc_threshold,
      rel_lambda     = params$reliability_lambda,
      max_iter       = params$max_iter, rel_tol = params$rel_tol,
      hours_in       = hours_tn,
      auto_occupancy = params$auto_occupancy,
      graph_sig      = digest::digest(list(
        cap_b = dodgr_graph_annotated$cap_vph_baseline,
        cap_p = dodgr_graph_annotated$cap_vph_priority,
        alpha = dodgr_graph_annotated$bpr_alpha_eff,  # per-edge BPR α
        seed  = seed_vec_tn)),
      transit_sig    = digest::digest(transit_skims[[cfg$gtfs_combo]]),
      drive_cost_per_mile  = DRIVE_COST_PER_MILE,
      transit_fare_default = TRANSIT_FARE_FALLBACK,
      mnl_coefs_sig        = digest::digest(B),
      parking_sig          = digest::digest(trips_in$parking_money_usd),
      cal_ratio_sig        = digest::digest(cal_lookup$cal_ratio),
      od_sig               = digest::digest(od_tn),
      # v15: reset broken bus-lane edges' time to free-flow for metrics (the
      # 1e7 routing penalty was contaminating VMT/speed/VZ). (v14: flow-MSA
      # convergence; v13: routing fix + bus-lane break; v12: cap 400→250 + α.)
      version              = "v15"
    )
    # Only enters the hash when set, so existing (uncalmed) caches stay valid.
    if (length(params$residential_calm_mph) == 1 &&
        is.finite(params$residential_calm_mph))
      scen_inputs$residential_calm <- params$residential_calm_mph
    if (length(params$residential_cap_vph) == 1 &&
        is.finite(params$residential_cap_vph))
      scen_inputs$residential_cap <- params$residential_cap_vph
    scen_hash <- substr(digest::digest(scen_inputs), 1, 12)
    scen_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, "scenario",
                            sprintf("scen_%s_%s_%s.rds",
                                    cfg$config_id, tn, scen_hash))
    bundle <- NULL
    if (file.exists(scen_cache) && !params$force_rebuild) {
      log_msg(sprintf("Scenario cache HIT for %s [%s, %s] — loading",
                      cfg$config_id, tn, scen_hash))
      bundle <- readRDS(scen_cache)
      required_fields <- c("converged_edge_data", "tod")
      missing <- setdiff(required_fields, names(bundle))
      if (length(missing) > 0) {
        log_msg(sprintf("Cache stale (missing: %s) — rebuilding",
                        paste(missing, collapse = ", ")))
        bundle <- NULL
      }
    }
    if (is.null(bundle)) {
      transit_skim_long <- transit_skims[[cfg$gtfs_combo]]
      if (is.null(transit_skim_long))
        stop("No transit skim for combo: ", cfg$gtfs_combo)

      res <- run_equilibrium_v2(
        config_row            = cfg,
        trips_in              = trips_in,
        transit_skim_long     = transit_skim_long,
        graph_in              = dodgr_graph_annotated,
        skim_drive_dodgr_in   = skim_drive_dodgr,
        od_demand_in          = od_tn,
        tod_bin               = tn,
        dow_type              = "Weekday",
        flow_seed_vec_in      = seed_vec_tn,
        od_cal_lookup_in      = cal_lookup,
        global_cal_ratio_in   = cal_global,
        hours_in              = hours_tn,
        residential_calm_mph  = params$residential_calm_mph,
        residential_cap_vph   = params$residential_cap_vph
      )

      log_msg(sprintf("[%s × %s] extracting metrics...", cfg$config_id, tn))
      mode_share_row    <- extract_mode_share(res, trips_in, cfg)
      transit_tt_row    <- extract_transit_tt_stats(
                              transit_skim_long, od_tn, cfg,
                              tod_bin = tn, dow_type = "Weekday")
      vmt_speed_row     <- extract_vmt_speed(res, cfg)
      emp_acc_long      <- tryCatch(
                            extract_employment_accessibility(
                              cfg$gtfs_combo, cfg,
                              tod_bin = tn, dow_type = "Weekday"),
                            error = function(e) {
                              log_sub(sprintf("employment_acc FAILED: %s",
                                              conditionMessage(e)))
                              tibble(config_id = cfg$config_id,
                                     tod = tn,
                                     GEOID = character(0),
                                     jobs_30min = numeric(0))
                            })
      bundle <- list(
        cfg                  = cfg,
        tod                  = tn,
        mode_share_row       = mode_share_row,
        transit_tt_row       = transit_tt_row,
        vmt_speed_row        = vmt_speed_row,
        emp_acc_long         = emp_acc_long,
        history              = res$history,
        od_skim_converged    = res$od_skim |>
                                select(origin_id, dest_id, car_tt_min_raw),
        diag_load            = res$diag_load,
        converged_edge_data  = capture_converged_edge_data(res),
        cost_inputs          = list(
          drive_cost_per_mile  = DRIVE_COST_PER_MILE,
          transit_fare_default = TRANSIT_FARE_FALLBACK,
          mnl_b_cost           = B$cost,
          mnl_b_drive_tt       = B$drive_tt,
          mnl_b_walk           = B$walking_min,
          mnl_b_bike           = B$bike_tt,
          mnl_b_transit_diff   = B$tr_diff,
          mnl_b_vc_drive       = B$vc_drive,
          parking_sig          = digest::digest(trips_in$parking_money_usd))
      )
      saveRDS(bundle, scen_cache)
    }

    # ---- Static-data extractors: now CACHED into the bundle. ----
    # walkshed / all-modes TT / employment-accessibility-by-mode / VMT-by-
    # category are the EXPENSIVE per-cell metrics (~minutes each, r5r/network
    # based). They USED to re-run on every cache HIT, so the final assembly pass
    # redid all 70 cells even though every equilibrium was a HIT (~2 hr wasted).
    # Now they're persisted in the bundle and only (re)computed when absent — a
    # fresh compute (in a parallel worker), or upgrading a pre-fix bundle — then
    # saved, so a HIT just loads them. (Body left un-reindented inside the guard
    # to keep this a minimal, reviewable diff.)
    .static_fields <- c("walkshed_row", "tt_stats_all_modes_long",
                        "emp_acc_by_mode_long", "vmt_by_category_long")
    if (!all(.static_fields %in% names(bundle))) {
    log_msg(sprintf("[%s × %s] running static-data extractors...",
                    cfg$config_id, tn))
    transit_skim_long <- transit_skims[[cfg$gtfs_combo]]
    vmt_row <- bundle$vmt_speed_row
    for (fn in c("extract_walkshed", "extract_tt_stats_all_modes",
                 "extract_employment_accessibility_by_mode",
                 "extract_vmt_by_category", "capture_converged_edge_data")) {
      if (!exists(fn)) stop("Function `", fn, "` not defined. ",
                            "Re-run §11 before §14.")
    }
    for (obj in c("od_drive_cal_lookup_per_tod",
                  "global_drive_cal_ratio_per_tod")) {
      if (!exists(obj)) stop("Object `", obj, "` not defined. Re-run §12.")
    }
    bundle$walkshed_row <- tryCatch(
      extract_walkshed(cfg$gtfs_combo, cfg),
      error = function(e) {
        log_sub(sprintf("walkshed FAILED: %s", conditionMessage(e)))
        tibble(config_id = cfg$config_id,
               n_stops_total = NA_integer_,
               walkshed_pct_seattle_total = NA_real_,
               n_stops_frequent_midday = NA_integer_,
               walkshed_pct_seattle_frequent = NA_real_,
               freq_headway_threshold_min = NA_real_,
               midday_window = NA_character_)
      })
    bundle$tt_stats_all_modes_long <- tryCatch(
      extract_tt_stats_all_modes(
        od_demand           = od_tn,
        transit_skim_long   = transit_skim_long,
        config_row          = cfg,
        avg_speed_mph       = vmt_row$avg_speed_mph,
        free_flow_speed_mph = vmt_row$free_flow_speed_mph,
        od_skim_converged   = bundle$od_skim_converged,
        tod_bin             = tn,
        dow_type            = "Weekday",
        od_cal_lookup_in    = cal_lookup,
        global_cal_ratio_in = cal_global),
      error = function(e) {
        log_sub(sprintf("tt_stats_all_modes FAILED: %s", conditionMessage(e)))
        tibble(config_id = cfg$config_id, tod = tn, mode = NA_character_,
               n_pairs = NA_integer_, mean_min = NA_real_,
               median_min = NA_real_, sd_min = NA_real_,
               weighted_trips = NA_real_)
      })
    bundle$emp_acc_by_mode_long <- tryCatch(
      extract_employment_accessibility_by_mode(
        transit_skim_long   = transit_skim_long,
        config_row          = cfg,
        avg_speed_mph       = vmt_row$avg_speed_mph,
        free_flow_speed_mph = vmt_row$free_flow_speed_mph,
        od_skim_converged   = bundle$od_skim_converged,
        tod_bin             = tn,
        dow_type            = "Weekday",
        od_cal_lookup_in    = cal_lookup,
        global_cal_ratio_in = cal_global),
      error = function(e) {
        log_sub(sprintf("emp_acc_by_mode FAILED: %s", conditionMessage(e)))
        tibble(config_id = cfg$config_id, tod = tn,
               GEOID = NA_character_,
               mode = NA_character_, jobs_30min = NA_real_)
      })
    bundle$vmt_by_category_long <- tryCatch(
      extract_vmt_by_category(bundle$converged_edge_data, cfg, way_snd_attrs),
      error = function(e) {
        log_sub(sprintf("vmt_by_category FAILED: %s", conditionMessage(e)))
        tibble(config_id = cfg$config_id, category = NA_character_,
               n_edges = NA_integer_, avg_vph = NA_real_,
               avg_capacity = NA_real_,
               total_vmt_peakhr = NA_real_,
               total_vehhr_peakhr = NA_real_,
               avg_speed_mph = NA_real_,
               pct_overcap = NA_real_,
               total_oversaturation_vph = NA_real_,
               mean_oversaturation_vph  = NA_real_,
               n_edges_oversaturated    = NA_integer_)
      })
    # Tag walkshed and vmt_by_category with TOD for downstream grouping.
    if (!"tod" %in% names(bundle$walkshed_row))
      bundle$walkshed_row$tod <- tn
    if (!"tod" %in% names(bundle$vmt_by_category_long))
      bundle$vmt_by_category_long$tod <- tn
    saveRDS(bundle, scen_cache)  # persist static extractors so HITs skip them
    } else {
      log_msg(sprintf("[%s × %s] static-data extractors: cache HIT (loaded from bundle)",
                      cfg$config_id, tn))
    }

    # Back-fill the flow-weighted V/C and overcap-VMT metrics onto the
    # cached vmt_speed_row from the (always-cached) converged_edge_data.
    # This way scenario caches built before these columns existed get
    # them transparently — no force_rebuild needed.
    if (!is.null(bundle$converged_edge_data) &&
        (!"pct_vmt_on_overcap" %in% names(bundle$vmt_speed_row) ||
         !"flow_weighted_vc"   %in% names(bundle$vmt_speed_row))) {
      .ed   <- bundle$converged_edge_data
      .flow <- .ed$flow_vph + .ed$flow_seed
      .mi   <- .ed$d_m / 1609.344
      .vc   <- .flow / pmax(.ed$cap_vph_eff, 1)
      .vmt_total <- sum(.flow * .mi, na.rm = TRUE)
      bundle$vmt_speed_row$pct_vmt_on_overcap <-
        if (.vmt_total > 0)
          100 * sum((.flow * .mi)[.vc > 1], na.rm = TRUE) / .vmt_total
        else NA_real_
      bundle$vmt_speed_row$flow_weighted_vc <-
        if (.vmt_total > 0)
          sum(.flow * .mi * .vc, na.rm = TRUE) / .vmt_total
        else NA_real_
    }

    results_list[[cell_idx]]    <- bundle
    results_emp_acc[[cell_idx]] <- bundle$emp_acc_long
    log_done(sprintf("CONFIG %s × TOD %s", cfg$config_id, tn), cell_t0)
    log_msg(sprintf("Cumulative pipeline time: %s",
                    fmt_dur(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), overall_t0,
                                                units = "secs")))))
  }
}

log_done("All configurations × TODs", overall_t0)

# Surface a side-by-side Daysim load comparison across the cells that ran.
# Each row is one (config × TOD); should show whether AV demand moved the
# actual loaded flow_vph relative to its no-AV control at the same TOD.
diag_compare <- bind_rows(lapply(results_list, function(b) {
  d <- b$diag_load
  if (is.null(d)) return(NULL)
  tibble(
    config_id        = b$cfg$config_id,
    tod              = b$tod,
    transit_label    = b$cfg$transit_label,
    street_label     = b$cfg$street_label,
    av_demand        = b$cfg$av_demand,
    full_drive_vph   = d$full_drive_vph,
    load_drive_vph   = d$load_drive_vph,
    load_efficiency_pct = 100 * d$flow_vph_vmt / pmax(d$load_vmt, 1),
    full_vmt_implied = d$full_vmt,
    load_vmt_implied = d$load_vmt,
    flow_vph_vmt     = d$flow_vph_vmt,
    flow_seed_vmt    = d$flow_seed_vmt,
    daysim_share_pct = 100 * d$flow_vph_vmt /
                       pmax(d$flow_vph_vmt + d$flow_seed_vmt, 1))
}))
if (nrow(diag_compare) > 0) {
  cat("\n========== Daysim load comparison across configs ==========\n")
  print(diag_compare, n = Inf, width = Inf)
  write_csv(diag_compare,
            file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "daysim_load_diagnostic.csv"))
  log_msg(sprintf("Wrote: %s/daysim_load_diagnostic.csv",
                  basename(OUTPUT_DIR)))
}
```


# 15. Cross-config summary tables

```{r summary-tables}
log_stage("Stage 15: Per-TOD raw + daily/annual aggregated summary tables")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# TOD bookkeeping. Modeled TODs = ones we actually ran equilibria for.
# Unmodeled TODs = filled in via literature ratios (tod_vmt_share,
# tod_share_fatal, tod_share_si, tod_seed_factor). The aggregation
# below uses both: daily metrics weight modeled TODs by their measured
# value and unmodeled TODs by their fraction of the daily-baseline.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
TODS_MODELED   <- params$tods_to_run
TODS_ALL       <- names(params$tod_bounds)
TODS_UNMODELED <- setdiff(TODS_ALL, TODS_MODELED)

# Coerce param lists to numeric named vectors for easy lookup.
.hr   <- vapply(TODS_ALL, function(t) as.numeric(params$tod_hours_per_day[[t]]),
                numeric(1))
.vmt_share   <- vapply(TODS_ALL, function(t) as.numeric(params$tod_vmt_share[[t]]),
                       numeric(1))
.fatal_share <- vapply(TODS_ALL, function(t) as.numeric(params$tod_share_fatal[[t]]),
                       numeric(1))
.si_share    <- vapply(TODS_ALL, function(t) as.numeric(params$tod_share_si[[t]]),
                       numeric(1))
names(.hr) <- TODS_ALL
names(.vmt_share)   <- TODS_ALL
names(.fatal_share) <- TODS_ALL
names(.si_share)    <- TODS_ALL

log_msg(sprintf("Modeled TODs: %s | Unmodeled (filled by ratios): %s",
                paste(TODS_MODELED, collapse = ", "),
                if (length(TODS_UNMODELED) > 0)
                  paste(TODS_UNMODELED, collapse = ", ") else "(none)"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-(config, TOD) raw tables. These are the modeled cells; downstream
# aggregation derives daily totals from them.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
mode_share_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(results_list, `[[`, "mode_share_row")) |>
  inner_join(configs_to_run |>
               select(config_id, transit_label, street_label,
                      transit_priority, av_demand),
             by = "config_id")
write_csv(mode_share_tbl,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "mode_share_by_config_tod.csv"))
print(mode_share_tbl)

transit_tt_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(results_list, `[[`, "transit_tt_row")) |>
  inner_join(configs_to_run |>
               select(config_id, transit_label, street_label),
             by = "config_id")
write_csv(transit_tt_tbl,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "transit_tt_stats_by_config_tod.csv"))
print(transit_tt_tbl)

vmt_speed_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(results_list, `[[`, "vmt_speed_row")) |>
  inner_join(configs_to_run |>
               select(config_id, transit_label, street_label),
             by = "config_id")
write_csv(vmt_speed_tbl,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "vmt_speed_by_config_tod.csv"))
print(vmt_speed_tbl)

# Walkshed is TOD-independent (a function of the per-config GTFS feed).
# Deduplicate to one row per config so downstream joins are 1-to-1.
walkshed_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(results_list, `[[`, "walkshed_row")) |>
  group_by(config_id) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-any_of("tod")) |>
  inner_join(configs_to_run |>
               select(config_id, transit_label, street_label),
             by = "config_id")
write_csv(walkshed_tbl,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "walkshed_by_config.csv"))
print(walkshed_tbl)

emp_acc_long <- bind_rows(results_emp_acc)
write_csv(emp_acc_long,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "employment_accessibility_by_tract_tod.csv"))

emp_acc_by_mode_long <- bind_rows(
  lapply(results_list, `[[`, "emp_acc_by_mode_long")) |>
  inner_join(configs_to_run |>
               select(config_id, transit_label, street_label),
             by = "config_id")
write_csv(emp_acc_by_mode_long,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "employment_accessibility_by_tract_mode_tod.csv"))

# Wide form (one row per (config, tract), modes as columns). Averages
# across modeled TODs in case multiple are run; with one modeled TOD
# this is just that TOD's value.
emp_acc_wide <- emp_acc_by_mode_long |>
  group_by(config_id, transit_label, street_label, GEOID, mode) |>
  summarise(jobs_30min = mean(jobs_30min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(config_id, transit_label, street_label, GEOID),
              names_from = mode, values_from = jobs_30min,
              names_prefix = "jobs_30min_")
write_csv(emp_acc_wide,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "employment_accessibility_by_tract_wide.csv"))

tt_stats_all_modes_tbl <- bind_rows(
  lapply(results_list, `[[`, "tt_stats_all_modes_long")) |>
  inner_join(configs_to_run |>
               select(config_id, transit_label, street_label),
             by = "config_id")
write_csv(tt_stats_all_modes_tbl,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "tt_stats_by_mode_config_tod.csv"))

vmt_by_category_tbl <- bind_rows(
  lapply(results_list, `[[`, "vmt_by_category_long")) |>
  inner_join(configs_to_run |>
               select(config_id, transit_label, street_label,
                      transit_priority, av_demand),
             by = "config_id") |>
  arrange(transit_label, street_label, desc(total_vmt_peakhr))
write_csv(vmt_by_category_tbl,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "vmt_speed_by_category_tod.csv"))

# Wide-by-config for vmt-by-category. Averages across modeled TODs
# (with one modeled TOD this is just that TOD's value). config_id column
# becomes one set of measures per config.
vmt_by_category_wide_src <- vmt_by_category_tbl |>
  group_by(config_id, category) |>
  summarise(
    avg_vph                = mean(avg_vph, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_speed_mph          = mean(avg_speed_mph, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_capacity           = mean(avg_capacity, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_overcap            = mean(pct_overcap, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_oversaturation_vph = mean(total_oversaturation_vph, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_edges_oversaturated  = mean(n_edges_oversaturated, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")
vmt_by_category_wide <- vmt_by_category_wide_src |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = category,
              names_from = config_id,
              values_from = c(avg_vph, avg_speed_mph,
                              avg_capacity, pct_overcap,
                              total_oversaturation_vph,
                              n_edges_oversaturated),
              names_glue = "{.value}__{config_id}")
write_csv(vmt_by_category_wide,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "vmt_speed_by_category_wide.csv"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-(config, tract) employment accessibility averaged across modeled
# TODs (used by RSE correlation and the legacy `_by_tract.csv` output).
# With one TOD modeled this is that TOD's value; multiple TODs are
# simple-mean averaged per (config, tract).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
emp_acc_tod_avg <- emp_acc_long |>
  group_by(config_id, GEOID) |>
  summarise(jobs_30min = mean(jobs_30min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(emp_acc_tod_avg,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "employment_accessibility_by_tract.csv"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Daily-aggregated VMT and speed per config.
#
# For each config:
#   modeled_daily_vmt   = sum over modeled TODs of (peak_vmt_t × hours_per_day_t)
#   modeled_vmt_share   = sum of tod_vmt_share over modeled TODs
#   daily_vmt_total     = modeled_daily_vmt / modeled_vmt_share
#                         (scales up using the literature share to fill in)
#   daily_vmt_unmodeled = daily_vmt_total × (1 - modeled_vmt_share)
#
# For the daily flow-weighted avg speed:
#   modeled_veh_hr_total = sum over modeled TODs of (veh_hours_peakhr_t × hours_t)
#   For unmodeled TODs we assume baseline-config speed (no scenario delta),
#   so vehicle-hours scale linearly with vmt share. This is a reasonable
#   conservative assumption — if you want stronger results, model PM too.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
modeled_vmt_share <- sum(.vmt_share[TODS_MODELED])
if (modeled_vmt_share <= 0)
  stop("No modeled TODs have a tod_vmt_share — check params$tod_vmt_share.")

vmt_speed_daily <- vmt_speed_tbl |>
  filter(tod %in% TODS_MODELED) |>
  mutate(
    hours_t           = .hr[tod],
    vmt_t_daily       = vmt_peakhr * hours_t,
    veh_hr_t_daily    = veh_hours_peakhr * hours_t) |>
  group_by(config_id, transit_label, street_label) |>
  summarise(
    n_tods_modeled        = dplyr::n(),
    modeled_vmt           = sum(vmt_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE),
    modeled_veh_hr        = sum(veh_hr_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_speed_modeled     = if (sum(veh_hr_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
       sum(vmt_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(veh_hr_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE)
       else NA_real_,
    # VMT-weighted aggregation across modeled TODs for the new
    # flow-weighted congestion metrics (treat each TOD's VMT as the
    # weight — the resulting daily values are the average across all
    # modeled hours, weighted by how much driving happens in each).
    pct_vmt_on_overcap    = if (sum(vmt_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
       sum(pct_vmt_on_overcap * vmt_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE) /
       sum(vmt_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE)
       else NA_real_,
    flow_weighted_vc      = if (sum(vmt_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
       sum(flow_weighted_vc * vmt_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE) /
       sum(vmt_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE)
       else NA_real_,
    pct_overcap_links     = if (sum(vmt_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
       sum(pct_overcap_links * vmt_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE) /
       sum(vmt_t_daily, na.rm = TRUE)
       else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    modeled_vmt_share     = modeled_vmt_share,
    # Scale up: modeled_vmt is `modeled_vmt_share` of daily; the rest
    # (unmodeled TODs) is filled at the daily-baseline share rate.
    daily_vmt_total       = modeled_vmt / modeled_vmt_share,
    daily_vmt_unmodeled   = daily_vmt_total - modeled_vmt,
    # Annual = daily × 365 (weekday-equivalent; weekend correction not
    # applied since TOD shares already account for weekly mix).
    annual_vmt            = daily_vmt_total * 365)
write_csv(vmt_speed_daily,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "vmt_speed_daily_by_config.csv"))
log_msg(sprintf("Daily VMT: modeled_vmt_share = %.2f%% (%d TOD modeled)",
                100 * modeled_vmt_share, length(TODS_MODELED)))
print(vmt_speed_daily)

# Same idea for mode share: daily mode share = trip-weighted average
# of per-TOD mode shares, where modeled TODs contribute their measured
# share × hours weight and unmodeled TODs contribute the baseline_no_pri_no_av
# config's per-TOD mode share at the same TOD (or fall back to default if
# no per-TOD baseline available).
#
# Practically: for AM-only runs, daily mode share = AM mode share.
# When all 5 TODs are modeled, it's an hours-weighted average.
mode_share_daily <- mode_share_tbl |>
  filter(tod %in% TODS_MODELED) |>
  mutate(hours_t = .hr[tod]) |>
  group_by(config_id, transit_label, street_label,
           transit_priority, av_demand) |>
  summarise(
    mode_drive_daily   = stats::weighted.mean(drive,   hours_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    mode_transit_daily = stats::weighted.mean(transit, hours_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    mode_walk_daily    = stats::weighted.mean(walk,    hours_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    mode_bike_daily    = stats::weighted.mean(bike,    hours_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_tods_modeled     = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop")
write_csv(mode_share_daily,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "mode_share_daily_by_config.csv"))

# Transit TT aggregated: hours+trips-weighted mean across modeled TODs.
# For single-TOD runs this is just that TOD's value.
transit_tt_by_config <- transit_tt_tbl |>
  filter(tod %in% TODS_MODELED) |>
  mutate(hours_t = .hr[tod]) |>
  group_by(config_id, transit_label, street_label) |>
  summarise(
    mean_min   = stats::weighted.mean(mean_min,   hours_t * weighted_trips,
                                       na.rm = TRUE),
    median_min = stats::weighted.mean(median_min, hours_t * weighted_trips,
                                       na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_min     = stats::weighted.mean(sd_min,     hours_t * weighted_trips,
                                       na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_trips_total = sum(weighted_trips, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")
write_csv(transit_tt_by_config,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "transit_tt_stats_by_config.csv"))

# Top-level per-config aggregates (thesis-ready). The *_tod.csv files
# above are diagnostics; these are the headline outputs.
write_csv(mode_share_daily,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "mode_share_by_config.csv"))
write_csv(vmt_speed_daily,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "vmt_speed_by_config.csv"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vision Zero — per-TOD-aware. Baseline annual fatalities (29.4) and SI
# (222.8) are distributed across TODs by literature shares (FARS/SDOT):
#   AM 6% / Midday 15% / PM 22% / Evening 26% / Night 31% (fatal)
# For each modeled (config, TOD), Hughes (VMT elasticity) × Nilsson
# (speed power law) is applied to that TOD's per-TOD baseline.
# For unmodeled TODs, we assume the scenario has no effect (factor = 1.0)
# — flag this as the conservative interpretation when only AM is modeled.
# Annual total = sum of all 5 TOD contributions.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
baseline_id <- "baseline__no_pri_no_av"

# Per-TOD baseline VMT and speed (from baseline config).
baseline_per_tod <- vmt_speed_tbl |>
  filter(config_id == baseline_id, tod %in% TODS_MODELED) |>
  transmute(tod, vmt_baseline = vmt_peakhr, speed_baseline = avg_speed_mph)

if (nrow(baseline_per_tod) == 0) {
  log_msg("WARNING: no baseline_no_pri_no_av rows in modeled TODs; ",
          "Vision Zero will be NA.")
  vz_tbl  <- NULL
  vz_long <- NULL
} else {
  # Per-modeled (config, TOD): vmt_ratio, speed_ratio, scaled fatalities + SI
  vz_modeled_long <- vmt_speed_tbl |>
    filter(tod %in% TODS_MODELED) |>
    inner_join(baseline_per_tod, by = "tod") |>
    mutate(
      vmt_ratio        = vmt_peakhr / pmax(vmt_baseline, 1e-9),
      speed_ratio      = avg_speed_mph / pmax(speed_baseline, 1e-9),
      fatal_baseline_t = params$vz_baseline_fatalities * .fatal_share[tod],
      si_baseline_t    = params$vz_baseline_si        * .si_share[tod],
      fatal_t          = fatal_baseline_t *
                          vmt_ratio^params$vz_hughes_elasticity *
                          speed_ratio^params$vz_nilsson_exp_fatal,
      si_t             = si_baseline_t *
                          vmt_ratio^params$vz_hughes_elasticity *
                          speed_ratio^params$vz_nilsson_exp_si,
      tod_status       = "modeled") |>
    select(config_id, tod, vmt_ratio, speed_ratio,
           fatal_baseline_t, si_baseline_t, fatal_t, si_t, tod_status)

  # For unmodeled TODs of each config, use the literature share with no
  # scenario adjustment (vmt_ratio = speed_ratio = 1.0). This is the
  # conservative interpretation: unmeasured TODs are assumed unchanged.
  vz_unmodeled_long <- if (length(TODS_UNMODELED) > 0) {
    tidyr::crossing(config_id = unique(vmt_speed_tbl$config_id),
                    tod       = TODS_UNMODELED) |>
      mutate(
        vmt_ratio        = 1,
        speed_ratio      = 1,
        fatal_baseline_t = params$vz_baseline_fatalities * .fatal_share[tod],
        si_baseline_t    = params$vz_baseline_si        * .si_share[tod],
        fatal_t          = fatal_baseline_t,
        si_t             = si_baseline_t,
        tod_status       = "filled (literature share)")
  } else tibble()

  vz_long <- bind_rows(vz_modeled_long, vz_unmodeled_long) |>
    inner_join(configs_to_run |>
                 select(config_id, transit_label, street_label,
                        transit_priority, av_demand),
               by = "config_id") |>
    arrange(config_id, factor(tod, levels = TODS_ALL))
  write_csv(vz_long, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "vision_zero_by_config_tod.csv"))

  # Annual aggregation
  vz_tbl <- vz_long |>
    group_by(config_id, transit_label, street_label,
             transit_priority, av_demand) |>
    summarise(
      projected_fatalities       = sum(fatal_t, na.rm = TRUE),
      projected_serious_injuries = sum(si_t,    na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_tods_modeled           = 100 * sum(tod_status == "modeled") /
                                          dplyr::n(),
      # Modeled-TOD-only contributions to fatalities (useful diagnostic)
      modeled_tod_fatalities     = sum(fatal_t[tod_status == "modeled"],
                                       na.rm = TRUE),
      modeled_tod_si             = sum(si_t[tod_status == "modeled"],
                                       na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop")
  write_csv(vz_tbl, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "vision_zero_by_config.csv"))
  print(vz_tbl)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Aggregate accessibility per (config, mode). Uses ALL modeled TODs
# averaged with hours-weighted weighting per origin tract.
# Trip-origin weighting: sum trips across all modeled TODs at each origin.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
trips_origin_by_tract <- od_daysim |>
  filter(!startsWith(origin_id, "GW_")) |>
  group_by(GEOID = origin_id) |>
  summarise(weight = sum(trips, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

acc_aggregate_tbl <- emp_acc_by_mode_long |>
  filter(!is.na(jobs_30min), !is.na(GEOID)) |>
  mutate(hours_t = .hr[tod]) |>
  left_join(trips_origin_by_tract, by = "GEOID") |>
  mutate(weight = coalesce(weight, 0)) |>
  group_by(config_id, transit_label, street_label, mode) |>
  summarise(
    n_origin_tracts          = dplyr::n_distinct(GEOID),
    n_tods                   = dplyr::n_distinct(tod),
    mean_jobs_30min          = mean(jobs_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_jobs_30min        = median(jobs_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_mean_jobs_30min = if (sum(weight * hours_t, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      stats::weighted.mean(jobs_30min, weight * hours_t, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    total_origin_weight      = sum(weight * hours_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(transit_label, street_label, mode)
write_csv(acc_aggregate_tbl,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "accessibility_aggregate_by_config.csv"))
print(acc_aggregate_tbl, n = Inf, width = Inf)

acc_wide_for_thesis <- acc_aggregate_tbl |>
  select(config_id, mode, weighted_mean_jobs_30min) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = mode, values_from = weighted_mean_jobs_30min,
              names_glue = "acc_{mode}_30min")
write_csv(acc_wide_for_thesis,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "accessibility_aggregate_wide.csv"))

# Equilibrium history (per config × tod × iter)
history_long <- bind_rows(lapply(results_list, `[[`, "history"))
write_csv(history_long,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "equilibrium_history_by_config_tod.csv"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# RSE correlation. Use the per-tract employment-access averaged across
# modeled TODs (computed above) as the per-config job-access vector for
# the equity correlation against the RSE composite index.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
baseline_emp <- emp_acc_tod_avg |> filter(config_id == baseline_id)
if (nrow(baseline_emp) > 0) {
  rse_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(unique(emp_acc_tod_avg$config_id), function(cid) {
    extract_rse_correlation(emp_acc_tod_avg |> filter(config_id == cid),
                            baseline_emp)
  })) |>
    inner_join(configs_to_run |>
                 select(config_id, transit_label, street_label),
               by = "config_id")
  write_csv(rse_tbl, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "rse_correlation_by_config.csv"))
  print(rse_tbl)
} else {
  rse_tbl <- NULL
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Single tidy "for the thesis" table. Per-config aggregates (daily
# mode share, daily VMT, annual fatalities). The columns ending in `_daily`
# / `annual_*` come from the per-TOD aggregation above; columns NOT ending
# in those suffixes are the FIRST-modeled-TOD's value (typically AM-peak)
# for back-compat with the existing thesis copy paste.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.default_tod <- TODS_MODELED[[1]]
log_msg("Building thesis summary — every metric aggregated to DAILY across modeled TODs (no AM-only columns).")

# DAILY values under the clean (back-compat) column names, so the thesis
# summary carries NO AM-only metric. Each source below is already aggregated
# across modeled TODs: mode_share_daily (hours-weighted), transit_tt_by_config
# (hours+trips-weighted), vmt_speed_daily (VMT-weighted). vmt_peakhr (an AM
# peak-hour figure) is dropped — daily_vmt_total carries the daily VMT.
mode_share_default <- mode_share_daily |>
  select(config_id,
         mode_drive   = mode_drive_daily, mode_transit = mode_transit_daily,
         mode_walk    = mode_walk_daily,  mode_bike    = mode_bike_daily)
transit_tt_default <- transit_tt_by_config |>
  select(config_id,
         transit_tt_mean_min   = mean_min,
         transit_tt_median_min = median_min,
         transit_tt_sd_min     = sd_min)
vmt_default <- vmt_speed_daily |>
  select(config_id, avg_speed_mph = avg_speed_modeled, pct_overcap_links,
         pct_vmt_on_overcap, flow_weighted_vc)

thesis_tbl <- configs_to_run |>
  select(config_id, transit_label, street_label,
         transit_priority, av_demand) |>
  left_join(mode_share_default, by = "config_id") |>
  left_join(transit_tt_default, by = "config_id") |>
  left_join(vmt_default, by = "config_id") |>
  left_join(walkshed_tbl |>
              select(config_id,
                     n_stops                       = n_stops_total,
                     walkshed_pct_seattle          = walkshed_pct_seattle_total,
                     n_stops_frequent_midday,
                     walkshed_pct_seattle_frequent),
            by = "config_id") |>
  left_join(acc_wide_for_thesis, by = "config_id") |>
  # Daily aggregates from per-TOD aggregation
  left_join(mode_share_daily |>
              select(config_id,
                     mode_drive_daily, mode_transit_daily,
                     mode_walk_daily, mode_bike_daily,
                     n_tods_modeled),
            by = "config_id") |>
  left_join(vmt_speed_daily |>
              select(config_id, modeled_vmt, daily_vmt_total,
                     annual_vmt, avg_speed_modeled,
                     pct_vmt_on_overcap_daily = pct_vmt_on_overcap,
                     flow_weighted_vc_daily   = flow_weighted_vc),
            by = "config_id")
if (!is.null(vz_tbl)) {
  thesis_tbl <- thesis_tbl |>
    left_join(vz_tbl |> select(config_id,
                               projected_fatalities,
                               projected_serious_injuries,
                               pct_tods_modeled),
              by = "config_id")
}
if (!is.null(rse_tbl)) {
  thesis_tbl <- thesis_tbl |>
    left_join(rse_tbl |> select(config_id, n_tracts, pearson_r, spearman_rho),
              by = "config_id")
}
write_csv(thesis_tbl, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "summary_for_thesis.csv"))

cat("\n--- summary_for_thesis (for paper copy-paste) ---\n")
knitr::kable(thesis_tbl, digits = 3)
```


# 16. Combined road-network GeoPackage export

Writes **one** GeoPackage (`output_phase2/arcgis_layers/network_full.gpkg`)
with everything needed for thesis maps. One row per **OSM way** (not per
dodgr contracted edge), all columns flat so ArcGIS/QGIS can symbolize
directly without joins.

**Geometry: real per-way polylines, not straight lines.** The contracted
dodgr graph collapses degree-2 vertex chains into single edges between
endpoints — those render as straight cuts across intermediate vertices
and look bad in ArcGIS. We instead load the **uncontracted** graph (one
edge per OSM coordinate pair), chain those edges by `way_id` + `geom_num`
to rebuild each way's true polyline geometry, then aggregate the
contracted-edge model outputs (flow, V/C, speed) up to the per-way level.

**Per-way aggregation rules:**
- `flow` columns = **sum** across direction (total throughput across the segment in both directions)
- `vc` columns = max V/C across direction (worst-case)
- `speed` columns = VMT-weighted harmonic mean across the way's edges
- `cap` / `lanes` columns come in **three variants**:
  - `*_same`: peak edge in the direction aligned with `snd_segdir`
  - `*_ops`: peak edge in the opposite direction
  - aggregate (no suffix): `same + ops` (total across both directions)

  For OSM-one-way features (Aurora NB / Aurora SB on their separate way_ids),
  only one side has edges, so the other side reads as `0`. For two-way OSM
  features matched to street-grid, both sides carry the SAMELANECOUNT-derived
  and OPSLANECOUNT-derived values respectively. For ways without an SND
  `snd_segdir` reference, all edges fall in `_same` and `_ops` is `0`.

## Column groups in the GeoPackage

**Street metadata** (from OSM + SDOT SND):
- `way_id`, `highway`, `category`, `art_descript`, `stname_ord`
- `snd_oneway`, `snd_oneway_dir`, `snd_segdir`
- `osm_oneway` (from OSM `oneway` tag), `effective_oneway` (SND first,
  OSM fallback — what the seed pipeline actually uses for dir_factor)
- `snd_arterial_code`, `snd_segment_type`
- `cap_source` ("art_descript" / "osm_highway")
- `d_m`, `edge_miles`, `t0_sec`, `free_flow_speed_mph`
- `bpr_alpha_eff`

**Capacity / lane structure** (Figure 3):
- `cap_baseline_same` / `cap_baseline_ops` / `cap_baseline` — per-direction
  baseline capacity (vph) for the SEGDIR-aligned (`_same`) and opposing
  (`_ops`) directions, plus their sum.
- `cap_priority_same` / `cap_priority_ops` / `cap_priority` — same after
  bus-lane re-allocation.
- `cap_delta_same` / `cap_delta_ops` / `cap_delta` — priority − baseline
  (negative on directions where lanes were taken for transit; zero
  elsewhere).
- `lanes_eff_same` / `lanes_eff_ops` / `lanes_eff` — per-direction lane
  counts and total.
- `new_lanes_eff_same` / `new_lanes_eff_ops` / `new_lanes_eff` — same after
  bus-lane re-allocation.
- `lanes_removed_same` / `lanes_removed_ops` / `lanes_removed` — current −
  post lanes.
- `cap_per_lane`, `bpr_alpha_eff` — per-class constants (same in both
  directions for a given way).
- `bus_lane_affected` (TRUE on ways with a proposed bus lane on at least
  one constituent COMPKEY).

**Per-TOD baseline raw values** (Figures 1, 2 — five-up by TOD):
For each TOD T ∈ {AM, Midday, PM, Evening, Night}:
- `bl_flow_T` — total flow (Daysim + seed) at T, baseline_no_pri_no_av
- `bl_vc_T`   — V/C ratio
- `bl_speed_T` — flow-weighted avg speed (mph)

**Daily-aggregated values per config** (Figures 4, 5, 6):
Hours-weighted across modeled TODs. For each of the 14 configs:
- `dly_<config_code>_flow` — average flow vph across modeled hours
- `dly_<config_code>_speed` — vehicle-mile-weighted average speed (mph)

**Daily deltas vs baseline_no_pri_no_av** (Figures 4-6 — the delta maps):
For each of the 13 non-baseline configs:
- `dly_<config_code>_dflow` — daily flow delta vs baseline_no_pri_no_av
- `dly_<config_code>_dspeed` — daily speed delta (mph) vs baseline

**Config-code mapping** (used in column suffixes to keep column names
manageable):
| Full config_id | Code |
|---|---|
| baseline__no_pri_no_av | `bsl_curr` |
| baseline__no_pri_av | `bsl_av` |
| baseline__pri_no_av | `bsl_pri` |
| baseline__pri_av | `bsl_priav` |
| triplicate__no_pri_no_av | `tx3_curr` |
| triplicate__no_pri_av | `tx3_av` |
| triplicate__pri_no_av | `tx3_pri` |
| triplicate__pri_av | `tx3_priav` |
| grid__pri_no_av | `grid_pri` |
| grid__pri_av | `grid_priav` |
| grid_local__pri_no_av | `gl_pri` |
| grid_local__pri_av | `gl_priav` |
| node__pri_no_av | `node_pri` |
| node__pri_av | `node_priav` |

## Thesis figure → column mapping

| Figure | Symbolize by | Layer filter (optional) |
|---|---|---|
| **1. Five-up baseline V/C by TOD** | `bl_vc_AM`, `bl_vc_Midday`, `bl_vc_PM`, `bl_vc_Evening`, `bl_vc_Night` | category in corridor list |
| **2. Five-up baseline volume by TOD** | `bl_flow_AM`, `bl_flow_Midday`, `bl_flow_PM`, `bl_flow_Evening`, `bl_flow_Night` | category in corridor list |
| **3a. Baseline lane capacity** | `cap_baseline` | – |
| **3b. Lanes removed for priority** | `lanes_removed` (`bus_lane_affected == TRUE`) | filter to bus-lane edges |
| **3c. Priority capacity** | `cap_priority` | – |
| **3d. Capacity delta (priority − baseline)** | `cap_delta` | – |
| **4. 3x Network daily speed deltas** | `dly_tx3_curr_dspeed`, `dly_tx3_av_dspeed`, `dly_tx3_pri_dspeed`, `dly_tx3_priav_dspeed` | – |
| **5. Grid+Local daily speed deltas** | `dly_gl_pri_dspeed`, `dly_gl_priav_dspeed` | – |
| **6a. 3x Network daily volume deltas** | `dly_tx3_curr_dflow`, `dly_tx3_av_dflow`, `dly_tx3_pri_dflow`, `dly_tx3_priav_dflow` | – |
| **6b. Grid+Local daily volume deltas** | `dly_gl_pri_dflow`, `dly_gl_priav_dflow` | – |

For each delta map, use a diverging color ramp (red = slower or less
flow, blue = faster or more flow) centered at zero.

## Daily aggregation formula

`daily_avg_speed_mph` is the harmonic mean of per-period speeds weighted
by VMT (the standard "speed experienced by an average vehicle-mile"):

```
daily_VMT = edge_miles × Σ (flow_t × hours_t)              over modeled TODs
daily_VHT = Σ (flow_t × time_weighted_t / 3600 × hours_t)  over modeled TODs
daily_avg_speed = daily_VMT / daily_VHT
```

`daily_flow_vph` is the time-weighted mean flow:
```
daily_flow_vph = Σ (flow_t × hours_t) / Σ hours_t          over modeled TODs
```

For edges with zero flow across all modeled TODs, `daily_avg_speed` is
the free-flow speed and `daily_flow_vph` is 0.

```{r export-network-gpkg}
log_stage("Stage 16: Combined road-network GeoPackage export (per-way polylines)")

arcgis_dir <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "arcgis_layers")
dir.create(arcgis_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- Load uncontracted graph for proper road geometry ----
# `dodgr_graph_annotated` is the *contracted* graph: degree-2 vertex
# chains are collapsed into one straight-line edge between endpoints.
# That looks terrible in ArcGIS — corridors get drawn as line segments
# that cut corners across intermediate vertices.
#
# For visualization we use the uncontracted graph (one edge per OSM
# coordinate pair) and chain those edges by way_id × geom_num to rebuild
# real road polylines.
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))

.uc_path  <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, "dodgr_graph_motorcar_p2_uncontracted.rds")
.uc_graph <- NULL
if (file.exists(.uc_path)) {
  log_msg(sprintf("Loading uncontracted graph: %s", basename(.uc_path)))
  .uc_t0 <- Sys.time()
  .uc_graph <- readRDS(.uc_path)
  log_done(sprintf("Loaded (%d edges)", nrow(.uc_graph)), .uc_t0)
}
if (is.null(.uc_graph)) {
  log_msg("Uncontracted graph not cached; building from PBF (~5 min)...")
  .uc_t0 <- Sys.time()
  drive_tags <- c("highway", "oneway", "maxspeed", "lanes",
                  "access", "motor_vehicle", "name", "ref",
                  "bridge", "tunnel")
  bb <- c(xmin = -122.55, ymin = 47.20, xmax = -121.95, ymax = 48.05)
  boundary_poly <- sf::st_as_sfc(sf::st_bbox(c(
    xmin = bb[["xmin"]], ymin = bb[["ymin"]],
    xmax = bb[["xmax"]], ymax = bb[["ymax"]]), crs = CRS_LL))
  streetnet_sf <- osmextract::oe_read(
    PBF_PATH, layer = "lines", extra_tags = drive_tags,
    boundary = boundary_poly, boundary_type = "spat",
    query = paste("SELECT * FROM lines WHERE highway IN (",
                  "'motorway','trunk','primary','secondary','tertiary',",
                  "'unclassified','residential','living_street',",
                  "'motorway_link','trunk_link','primary_link',",
                  "'secondary_link','tertiary_link')"),
    quiet = TRUE)
  # Normalize oneway same as §2
  .ow_norm <- toupper(trimws(as.character(streetnet_sf$oneway)))
  .ow_norm[is.na(streetnet_sf$oneway) | .ow_norm == ""] <- "NO"
  streetnet_sf$oneway <- dplyr::case_when(
    .ow_norm %in% c("YES","TRUE","1")               ~ "yes",
    .ow_norm %in% c("NO","FALSE","0","-1",
                    "REVERSIBLE","ALTERNATING")     ~ "no",
    TRUE                                            ~ "no")
  # keep_cols: the OSM attributes written per way to network_full.gpkg below.
  .uc_graph <- dodgr::weight_streetnet(streetnet_sf, wt_profile = "motorcar",
                                       turn_penalty = FALSE,
                                       keep_cols = c("lanes", "maxspeed", "name", "ref"))
  saveRDS(.uc_graph, .uc_path)
  log_done("Built and cached uncontracted graph", .uc_t0)
}

# Coerce to plain data.frame for downstream dplyr / data.table ops.
class(.uc_graph) <- c("tbl_df", "tbl", "data.frame")
# Some dodgr versions emit a duplicate `lanes` column.
.dup_idx <- which(duplicated(names(.uc_graph)))
if (length(.dup_idx) > 0) .uc_graph <- .uc_graph[, -.dup_idx]

# Driveable filter (matches the contracted graph's class list).
DRIVEABLE_VIZ <- c("motorway","motorway_link","trunk","trunk_link",
                   "primary","primary_link","secondary","secondary_link",
                   "tertiary","tertiary_link","unclassified","residential",
                   "living_street")
.uc_graph <- .uc_graph |>
  filter(as.character(highway) %in% DRIVEABLE_VIZ) |>
  mutate(way_id = as.character(way_id))
log_msg(sprintf("Uncontracted driveable edges: %d", nrow(.uc_graph)))

# ---- Build per-way polylines by chaining uncontracted edges ----
# Within each way, edges are ordered by `geom_num` (1..N). The polyline
# is the union of from_lon/from_lat for the first edge plus every edge's
# to_lon/to_lat. De-dupe consecutive identical points (sub-edge boundaries
# at the same coordinate) before constructing the linestring.
log_msg("Building per-way polylines from uncontracted edges...")
.geom_t0 <- Sys.time()
.uc_graph <- .uc_graph |> arrange(way_id, geom_num)
.uc_dt <- as.data.table(.uc_graph)

way_geoms_dt <- .uc_dt[, {
  coords <- rbind(
    cbind(from_lon[1], from_lat[1]),
    cbind(to_lon, to_lat))
  # De-dupe consecutive identical points (some OSM ways have repeated
  # coordinates at sub-segment boundaries).
  keep <- c(TRUE, !(coords[-1, 1] == coords[-nrow(coords), 1] &
                    coords[-1, 2] == coords[-nrow(coords), 2]))
  coords <- coords[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  list(n_edges_uc = .N,
       total_length_m = sum(d, na.rm = TRUE),
       coords = list(coords))
}, by = way_id]

# Convert per-way coordinate matrices to sf LINESTRINGs.
way_sfc <- sf::st_sfc(
  lapply(way_geoms_dt$coords, function(m) {
    if (nrow(m) >= 2) sf::st_linestring(m) else sf::st_point(m[1, ])
  }),
  crs = 4326)
way_geom <- tibble(
  way_id         = as.character(way_geoms_dt$way_id),
  n_edges_uc     = way_geoms_dt$n_edges_uc,
  total_length_m = way_geoms_dt$total_length_m,
  geometry       = way_sfc
)
log_done(sprintf("Built %d per-way LINESTRINGs", nrow(way_geom)), .geom_t0)

# ---- Per-way OSM raw attributes (from uncontracted graph) ----
# Pick "majority highway" per way (in case of mixed; rare). Take first
# for free-text fields (name, ref, maxspeed) and parse `lanes` to numeric.
.hwy_modes <- .uc_dt[, .N, by = .(way_id, highway)
                    ][order(-N), .SD[1L], by = way_id][, .(way_id, highway)]
.way_osm_attrs <- .uc_dt[, .(
  osm_lanes_raw = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(lanes[1])),
  osm_maxspeed  = as.character(maxspeed[1]),
  osm_name      = as.character(name[1]),
  osm_ref       = as.character(ref[1])
), by = way_id]
.way_osm_attrs[, highway := .hwy_modes$highway[match(way_id,
                                                     .hwy_modes$way_id)]]
.way_osm_attrs <- as_tibble(.way_osm_attrs) |>
  mutate(way_id = as.character(way_id))

# ---- Config-code mapping for column suffixes ----
.config_codes <- c(
  "baseline__no_pri_no_av"   = "bsl_curr",
  "baseline__no_pri_av"      = "bsl_av",
  "baseline__pri_no_av"      = "bsl_pri",
  "baseline__pri_av"         = "bsl_priav",
  "triplicate__no_pri_no_av" = "tx3_curr",
  "triplicate__no_pri_av"    = "tx3_av",
  "triplicate__pri_no_av"    = "tx3_pri",
  "triplicate__pri_av"       = "tx3_priav",
  "grid__pri_no_av"          = "grid_pri",
  "grid__pri_av"             = "grid_priav",
  "grid_local__pri_no_av"    = "gl_pri",
  "grid_local__pri_av"       = "gl_priav",
  "node__pri_no_av"          = "node_pri",
  "node__pri_av"             = "node_priav"
)

# ---- Per-way SDOT + per-way contracted-graph aggregation ----
# Bring SDOT metadata at way granularity (already 1 row per way).
.snd_lookup <- way_snd_attrs |>
  mutate(way_id = as.character(way_id)) |>
  select(way_id, art_descript, stname_ord, ord_stname_concat,
         snd_oneway, snd_oneway_dir, snd_segdir,
         snd_arterial_code, snd_segment_type)

# The contracted graph has multiple rows per way (one per directional
# contracted edge). To preserve per-direction information, we classify
# each edge as "same" (bearing aligned with the way's snd_segdir) or
# "ops" (opposite), then emit BOTH _same/_ops columns AND a sum aggregate.
# Length / oneway / bus-lane columns stay per-way (one value each).
.has_new_lanes <- "new_lanes_eff" %in% names(dodgr_graph_annotated)
.has_bus_aff   <- "bus_lane_affected" %in% names(dodgr_graph_annotated)
.has_art_desc  <- "art_descript" %in% names(dodgr_graph_annotated)
.has_eff_oneway <- "effective_oneway" %in% names(dodgr_graph_annotated)
.has_osm_oneway <- "osm_oneway" %in% names(dodgr_graph_annotated)

# Cardinal-bearing lookup (mirrors §5 bus-lane logic, redefined locally
# because that one is scoped inside a with_cache function body).
.cardinal_bearing <- c(N =   0, NE = 45,  E = 90,  SE = 135,
                       S = 180, SW = 225, W = 270, NW = 315)

# Per-edge long table with bearing classification vs snd_segdir.
.edges_long <- tibble(
  way_id        = as.character(dgr_way_id(dodgr_graph_annotated)),
  cap_b_edge    = as.numeric(dodgr_graph_annotated$cap_vph_baseline),
  cap_p_edge    = as.numeric(dodgr_graph_annotated$cap_vph_priority),
  cap_per_ln    = as.numeric(dodgr_graph_annotated$cap_per_lane),
  bpr_alpha     = as.numeric(dodgr_graph_annotated$bpr_alpha_eff),
  lanes_e       = as.numeric(dodgr_graph_annotated$lanes_eff),
  new_lanes_e   = if (.has_new_lanes)
                    as.numeric(dodgr_graph_annotated$new_lanes_eff) else
                    as.numeric(dodgr_graph_annotated$lanes_eff),
  bus_aff_e     = if (.has_bus_aff)
                    as.logical(dodgr_graph_annotated$bus_lane_affected) else
                    rep(FALSE, nrow(dodgr_graph_annotated)),
  art_desc_g_e  = if (.has_art_desc)
                    as.character(dodgr_graph_annotated$art_descript) else
                    rep(NA_character_, nrow(dodgr_graph_annotated)),
  eff_oneway_e  = if (.has_eff_oneway)
                    as.logical(dodgr_graph_annotated$effective_oneway) else
                    rep(NA, nrow(dodgr_graph_annotated)),
  osm_oneway_e  = if (.has_osm_oneway)
                    as.logical(dodgr_graph_annotated$osm_oneway) else
                    rep(NA, nrow(dodgr_graph_annotated)),
  d_m_contracted    = as.numeric(dodgr_graph_annotated$d),
  t0_sec_contracted = as.numeric(dodgr_graph_annotated$t0_sec),
  edge_bear         = .edge_bearing(
    dgr_from_x(dodgr_graph_annotated), dgr_from_y(dodgr_graph_annotated),
    dgr_to_x(dodgr_graph_annotated),   dgr_to_y(dodgr_graph_annotated))
) |>
  left_join(.snd_lookup |> select(way_id, snd_segdir),
            by = "way_id") |>
  mutate(
    segdir_bear = unname(.cardinal_bearing[snd_segdir]),
    bearing_gap = if_else(!is.na(segdir_bear),
                          pmin(abs(edge_bear - segdir_bear),
                               360 - abs(edge_bear - segdir_bear)),
                          NA_real_),
    # Classify side. When snd_segdir is missing (ways outside SDOT's
    # network), default to "same" so values appear there rather than
    # disappearing into an empty "ops" bucket.
    side = case_when(
      !is.na(bearing_gap) & bearing_gap < 90  ~ "same",
      !is.na(bearing_gap) & bearing_gap >= 90 ~ "ops",
      TRUE                                     ~ "same"))

# Non-directional per-way aggregates (length, oneway flags, bus-lane,
# art_descript). These don't split by direction.
.per_way_static <- .edges_long |>
  group_by(way_id) |>
  summarise(
    n_edges_contracted    = dplyr::n(),
    bus_lane_affected     = any(bus_aff_e,  na.rm = TRUE),
    art_descript_g        = {
      v <- na.omit(art_desc_g_e); if (length(v)) v[1] else NA_character_
    },
    effective_oneway      = any(eff_oneway_e, na.rm = TRUE),
    osm_oneway            = any(osm_oneway_e, na.rm = TRUE),
    d_m_contracted_sum    = sum(d_m_contracted,    na.rm = TRUE),
    t0_sec_contracted_sum = sum(t0_sec_contracted, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

# Directional per-(way, side) aggregates: peak edge value within each side.
.per_way_dir_long <- .edges_long |>
  group_by(way_id, side) |>
  summarise(
    cap_baseline   = max(cap_b_edge, na.rm = TRUE),
    cap_priority   = max(cap_p_edge, na.rm = TRUE),
    cap_per_lane   = max(cap_per_ln, na.rm = TRUE),
    bpr_alpha_eff  = max(bpr_alpha,  na.rm = TRUE),
    lanes_eff      = max(lanes_e,    na.rm = TRUE),
    new_lanes_eff  = max(new_lanes_e, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

# Ensure every way has a "same" and "ops" row (even if all of one side's
# values are zero) so pivot_wider always produces both columns.
.per_way_dir <- .per_way_dir_long |>
  tidyr::complete(way_id, side = c("same", "ops"),
                  fill = list(cap_baseline  = 0, cap_priority  = 0,
                              cap_per_lane  = 0, bpr_alpha_eff = 0,
                              lanes_eff     = 0, new_lanes_eff = 0)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = way_id,
    names_from  = side,
    values_from = c(cap_baseline, cap_priority, cap_per_lane,
                    bpr_alpha_eff, lanes_eff, new_lanes_eff),
    names_glue  = "{.value}_{side}",
    values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(across(matches("^(cap_baseline|cap_priority|lanes_eff|new_lanes_eff)_(same|ops)$"),
                ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0))) |>
  mutate(
    # ---- Direction-additive sums (lanes, capacity) ----
    cap_baseline  = cap_baseline_same + cap_baseline_ops,
    cap_priority  = cap_priority_same + cap_priority_ops,
    lanes_eff     = lanes_eff_same    + lanes_eff_ops,
    new_lanes_eff = new_lanes_eff_same + new_lanes_eff_ops,
    # ---- Per-class values (identical across directions in practice) ----
    cap_per_lane  = pmax(coalesce(cap_per_lane_same,  0),
                         coalesce(cap_per_lane_ops,   0)),
    bpr_alpha_eff = pmax(coalesce(bpr_alpha_eff_same, 0),
                         coalesce(bpr_alpha_eff_ops,  0)),
    # ---- Derived deltas (same/ops + aggregate) ----
    cap_delta_same    = cap_priority_same - cap_baseline_same,
    cap_delta_ops     = cap_priority_ops  - cap_baseline_ops,
    cap_delta         = cap_priority - cap_baseline,
    lanes_removed_same = lanes_eff_same - new_lanes_eff_same,
    lanes_removed_ops  = lanes_eff_ops  - new_lanes_eff_ops,
    lanes_removed      = lanes_eff      - new_lanes_eff)

.contracted_per_way <- .per_way_static |>
  left_join(.per_way_dir, by = "way_id")

# Combine static per-way attributes (geometry + OSM + SDOT + contracted).
static_attrs <- way_geom |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  inner_join(.way_osm_attrs, by = "way_id") |>
  left_join(.snd_lookup, by = "way_id") |>
  left_join(.contracted_per_way, by = "way_id") |>
  mutate(
    # Prefer the graph's `art_descript` (already joined during §5
    # annotation) over the standalone SND lookup, since the graph's
    # value is what actually drove cap_per_lane / bpr_alpha_eff.
    art_descript = coalesce(art_descript_g, art_descript),
    cap_source = ifelse(!is.na(art_descript), "art_descript", "osm_highway"),
    category = case_when(
      !is.na(art_descript) & nzchar(art_descript) ~ art_descript,
      highway %in% c("motorway","motorway_link","trunk","trunk_link",
                     "primary","primary_link")    ~ "unknown highway",
      highway %in% c("secondary","secondary_link",
                     "tertiary","tertiary_link")  ~ "unknown arterial",
      highway %in% c("residential","unclassified",
                     "living_street","service")   ~ "unknown residential",
      TRUE                                          ~ "unknown other"),
    total_length_mi     = total_length_m / 1609.344,
    free_flow_speed_mph = total_length_mi /
                          pmax(t0_sec_contracted_sum / 3600, 1e-9)
  ) |>
  select(-art_descript_g, -d_m_contracted_sum, -t0_sec_contracted_sum)

log_msg(sprintf("static_attrs: %d ways × %d cols",
                nrow(static_attrs), ncol(static_attrs)))

# ---- Per-(config, tod, way_id) cell data ----
# For each bundle, aggregate contracted-edge metrics to per-way:
#   flow_max  : peak direction's flow_vph + flow_seed
#   flow_sum  : sum across both directions of way (total throughput)
#   cap_max   : peak direction's cap
#   vc_max    : peak direction's V/C
#   vmt_way   : Σ flow × edge_miles across way's edges (vehicle-miles/hr)
#   vht_way   : Σ flow × time_weighted/3600 (vehicle-hours/hr)
#   speed_way : vmt_way / vht_way (VMT-weighted harmonic speed)
log_msg("Aggregating per-(cell, way) contracted-edge data...")
.cell_t0 <- Sys.time()

.way_ids_contracted <- as.character(dgr_way_id(dodgr_graph_annotated))

all_cell_data_per_way <- lapply(seq_along(results_list), function(i) {
  b <- results_list[[i]]
  if (is.null(b) || is.null(b$converged_edge_data)) return(NULL)
  ed <- b$converged_edge_data
  if (nrow(ed) != length(.way_ids_contracted)) {
    log_sub(sprintf("  %s [%s]: edge-count mismatch — SKIPPING",
                    b$cfg$config_id, b$tod))
    return(NULL)
  }
  flow_total <- ed$flow_vph + ed$flow_seed
  miles_e    <- ed$d_m / 1609.344
  tibble(
    way_id     = .way_ids_contracted,
    config_id  = b$cfg$config_id,
    config_code = unname(.config_codes[b$cfg$config_id]),
    tod        = b$tod,
    flow_e     = flow_total,
    cap_e      = as.numeric(ed$cap_vph_eff),
    vc_e       = flow_total / pmax(ed$cap_vph_eff, 1),
    vmt_e      = flow_total * miles_e,
    vht_e      = flow_total * ed$time_weighted / 3600
  ) |>
    group_by(way_id, config_id, config_code, tod) |>
    summarise(
      flow_max = max(flow_e, na.rm = TRUE),
      flow_sum = sum(flow_e, na.rm = TRUE),
      cap_max  = max(cap_e,  na.rm = TRUE),
      vc_max   = max(vc_e,   na.rm = TRUE),
      vmt_way  = sum(vmt_e,  na.rm = TRUE),
      vht_way  = sum(vht_e,  na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(speed_way = if_else(vht_way > 0, vmt_way / vht_way, NA_real_))
}) |> bind_rows()
log_done(sprintf("Per-(cell, way) rows: %d", nrow(all_cell_data_per_way)),
         .cell_t0)

# ---- Per-TOD baseline columns (one column per TOD per metric) ----
log_msg("Pivoting per-TOD baseline columns...")
.tods_in_data <- sort(unique(all_cell_data_per_way$tod))

baseline_per_tod <- all_cell_data_per_way |>
  filter(config_id == "baseline__no_pri_no_av") |>
  # flow uses sum-across-direction (total throughput on the segment);
  # vc keeps max (worst-case hotspot); speed is the VMT-weighted harmonic.
  select(way_id, tod, flow_sum, vc_max, speed_way) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = way_id,
    names_from  = tod,
    values_from = c(flow_sum, vc_max, speed_way),
    names_glue  = "bl_{.value}_{tod}") |>
  rename_with(~ gsub("^bl_flow_sum_",  "bl_flow_",  .x)) |>
  rename_with(~ gsub("^bl_vc_max_",    "bl_vc_",    .x)) |>
  rename_with(~ gsub("^bl_speed_way_", "bl_speed_", .x))
log_msg(sprintf("  baseline_per_tod: %d ways × %d cols",
                nrow(baseline_per_tod), ncol(baseline_per_tod) - 1))

# ---- Daily aggregated values per config (across modeled TODs) ----
log_msg("Computing daily-aggregated per-config flow + speed...")
.daily_t0 <- Sys.time()

.hours_per_tod <- vapply(.tods_in_data, function(t) {
  v <- as.numeric(params$tod_hours_per_day[[t]])
  if (is.null(v) || !is.finite(v) || v <= 0) NA_real_ else v
}, numeric(1))
names(.hours_per_tod) <- .tods_in_data

daily_per_config <- all_cell_data_per_way |>
  mutate(
    hours_t = .hours_per_tod[tod],
    # Daily flow uses sum-across-direction (matches baseline_per_tod).
    # Speed remains VMT-weighted harmonic; deltas vs baseline below
    # inherit the sum-based flow.
    flow_hr = flow_sum * hours_t,
    vmt_hr  = vmt_way  * hours_t,
    vht_hr  = vht_way  * hours_t
  ) |>
  group_by(way_id, config_code) |>
  summarise(
    sum_flow_hr = sum(flow_hr, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_hours   = sum(hours_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_vmt_hr  = sum(vmt_hr,  na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_vht_hr  = sum(vht_hr,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    daily_flow  = if_else(sum_hours > 0, sum_flow_hr / sum_hours, NA_real_),
    daily_speed = if_else(sum_vht_hr > 0, sum_vmt_hr / sum_vht_hr, NA_real_)
  ) |>
  select(way_id, config_code, daily_flow, daily_speed) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = way_id,
    names_from  = config_code,
    values_from = c(daily_flow, daily_speed),
    names_glue  = "{.value}_{config_code}") |>
  rename_with(~ gsub("^daily_flow_(.+)$",  "dly_\\1_flow",  .x)) |>
  rename_with(~ gsub("^daily_speed_(.+)$", "dly_\\1_speed", .x))
log_done(sprintf("daily_per_config: %d ways × %d cols",
                 nrow(daily_per_config), ncol(daily_per_config) - 1),
         .daily_t0)

# ---- Daily delta-vs-baseline columns ----
log_msg("Computing daily deltas vs baseline_no_pri_no_av...")
.base_flow  <- daily_per_config$dly_bsl_curr_flow
.base_speed <- daily_per_config$dly_bsl_curr_speed
.delta_cols <- daily_per_config |> select(way_id)
for (code in setdiff(.config_codes, "bsl_curr")) {
  flow_col   <- paste0("dly_", code, "_flow")
  speed_col  <- paste0("dly_", code, "_speed")
  dflow_col  <- paste0("dly_", code, "_dflow")
  dspeed_col <- paste0("dly_", code, "_dspeed")
  if (flow_col %in% names(daily_per_config))
    .delta_cols[[dflow_col]]  <- daily_per_config[[flow_col]]  - .base_flow
  if (speed_col %in% names(daily_per_config))
    .delta_cols[[dspeed_col]] <- daily_per_config[[speed_col]] - .base_speed
}
log_msg(sprintf("  delta_cols: %d delta-cols added", ncol(.delta_cols) - 1))

# ---- Combine into one wide tibble (one row per way) ----
log_msg("Joining static + baseline-per-TOD + daily + deltas...")
combined <- static_attrs |>
  left_join(baseline_per_tod, by = "way_id") |>
  left_join(daily_per_config, by = "way_id") |>
  left_join(.delta_cols,      by = "way_id")

# Round numeric columns to keep file size manageable.
combined <- combined |>
  mutate(across(c(total_length_m, total_length_mi, free_flow_speed_mph),
                ~ round(.x, 2)),
         across(matches("^bl_flow_"), ~ round(.x, 1)),
         across(matches("^bl_vc_"),   ~ round(.x, 3)),
         across(matches("^bl_speed_"),~ round(.x, 2)),
         across(matches("^dly_.*_flow$"),  ~ round(.x, 1)),
         across(matches("^dly_.*_speed$"), ~ round(.x, 2)),
         across(matches("^dly_.*_dflow$"), ~ round(.x, 1)),
         across(matches("^dly_.*_dspeed$"),~ round(.x, 2)),
         across(matches("^cap_(baseline|priority|delta|per_lane)(_same|_ops)?$"),
                ~ round(.x, 0)),
         across(matches("^(lanes_eff|new_lanes_eff|lanes_removed)(_same|_ops)?$"),
                ~ round(.x, 1)),
         across(matches("^bpr_alpha_eff(_same|_ops)?$"),
                ~ round(.x, 3)))
log_msg(sprintf("Combined table: %d ways × %d columns",
                nrow(combined), ncol(combined)))

# ---- Filter to keep the full driveable network ----
# Initial filter dropped local residentials with zero modeled flow, but
# that left visual gaps in the street grid (arterials rendered cleanly
# but side streets disappeared — confusing for debugging since you'd
# wonder if those streets were "removed from the network"). Now we keep
# every way in the standard driveable OSM classes (motorway → living
# street); ways without flow data show up as gray context lines that
# you can choose to symbolize or filter out in ArcGIS.
DRIVEABLE_VIZ_KEEP <- c(
  "motorway","motorway_link","trunk","trunk_link",
  "primary","primary_link","secondary","secondary_link",
  "tertiary","tertiary_link","unclassified","residential","living_street")
keep <- !is.na(combined$highway) & combined$highway %in% DRIVEABLE_VIZ_KEEP
log_msg(sprintf("  Filter: keeping %d / %d ways (%.1f%% — full driveable network)",
                sum(keep), nrow(combined), 100 * mean(keep)))

# ---- Attach geometry and write ----
combined_kept <- combined[keep, , drop = FALSE]
# Attach geometry by positional match (dplyr's inner_join coerces the
# `geometry` column to a plain list and strips the `sfc` class, which
# breaks sf::st_as_sf). Pull the geometry vector directly so it stays
# an sfc with proper CRS metadata.
.geom_idx <- match(combined_kept$way_id, way_geom$way_id)
.missing_geom <- sum(is.na(.geom_idx))
if (.missing_geom > 0) {
  log_msg(sprintf("  WARNING: %d ways in combined have no geometry; dropping",
                  .missing_geom))
  combined_kept <- combined_kept[!is.na(.geom_idx), , drop = FALSE]
  .geom_idx     <- .geom_idx[!is.na(.geom_idx)]
}
feat <- sf::st_sf(combined_kept,
                  geometry = way_geom$geometry[.geom_idx],
                  crs = 4326)

out_path <- file.path(arcgis_dir, "network_full.gpkg")
log_msg(sprintf("Writing %s ...", out_path))
.write_t0 <- Sys.time()
sf::st_write(feat, out_path, layer = "edges",
             delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE,
             driver = "GPKG")
log_done(sprintf("Wrote %.1f MB",
                 file.info(out_path)$size / 1024^2), .write_t0)

log_msg("---- Column groups in network_full.gpkg ----")
log_sub(sprintf("  Metadata cols:    %d", ncol(static_attrs) - 1))  # -way_id
log_sub(sprintf("  Per-TOD baseline: %d (3 metrics × %d TODs)",
                ncol(baseline_per_tod) - 1, length(.tods_in_data)))
log_sub(sprintf("  Per-config daily: %d (2 metrics × 14 configs)",
                ncol(daily_per_config) - 1))
log_sub(sprintf("  Per-config delta: %d (2 metrics × 13 non-base configs)",
                ncol(.delta_cols) - 1))
log_sub(sprintf("  Geometry:         per-way LINESTRING (n_edges_uc avg %.1f)",
                mean(combined_kept$n_edges_uc, na.rm = TRUE)))
log_sub(sprintf("  GRAND TOTAL:      %d cols × %d features",
                ncol(combined_kept), nrow(combined_kept)))
log_msg("")
log_msg(sprintf("Open in ArcGIS Pro: Add Data → %s → edges",
                basename(out_path)))
log_msg("Suggested symbology recipes for thesis figures in §16 chunk doc above.")
```


# 17. Run metadata

```{r run-metadata}
total_secs <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), .log_start_time, units = "secs"))
metadata <- list(
  run_finished_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
  total_seconds   = total_secs,
  total_minutes   = total_secs / 60,
  n_threads       = N_VCPU,
  java_heap_gb    = params$java_heap_gb,
  configurations_run  = nrow(configs_to_run),
  tods_run            = TODS_MODELED,
  tods_filled         = TODS_UNMODELED,
  cells_run           = n_cells,
  tod_hours_per_day   = .hr,
  tod_vmt_share       = .vmt_share,
  tod_share_fatal     = .fatal_share,
  tod_share_si        = .si_share,
  modeled_vmt_share   = modeled_vmt_share,
  av_drive_tt_shrink  = params$av_drive_tt_shrink,
  bpr = list(
```
